# The entry points of the closure gate: one Lean constant per line, the functions the C exports `vbm_json_*` call. `LeanJson.parseTapeSimd` is the export `vbm_json_parse_tape`
# (the bit-parallel parser; it returns the bytes of `parseTapeFast`, `parseTapeSimd_eq`, and falls back to it, so it reaches `parseTapeFast` too); `LeanJson.parseFast` is the parser the fallback follows, kept as an entry
# of its own (the proved claims are about it). The other exports are added with the ABI.
LeanJson.parseFast
LeanJson.parseTapeSimd
LeanJson.printTapeExport
LeanJson.escapeStringExport
